description:
A live bar in the Windows 11 taskbar search box for Claude Code and Codex, music, timers and file search.

IsleBar turns the Windows 11 taskbar search box into a live bar.
Ask Claude Code or Codex from the taskbar and see when the agent is working, needs your answer or is done.
It also shows the song that is playing, timers and pomodoros, downloads and short system notices,
and searches files (with Everything) or the web. Free and open source.
